notes.title: Week 1 Patch 4
notes.notes:
Dear Judge,
Based on your feedback, we’ve made further optimizations and fixes to improve the game.

Adjustments

[list]
[*] Added a fast resource collection feature for Hashrate and Region.
Players can choose to acquire random resources at no cost or spend 1 Data Packets to instantly achieve your personal high score * and collect the corresponding resources into your inventory.
*Note: The "high score" here specifically refers to scores recorded after version 1.0.8.
[/list]

Bug Fixes

[i][strike][list]
[*] Once again, we humbly corrected some embarrassing typos.
[/list][/strike][/i]

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Week 1 Patch 2 (Mini-games, Plugin Adjustments, and Known Bug Fixes) & Our Thank
notes.notes:
Dear Judge,
Since the release of Lightracer: For Judge, we have received numerous suggestions and words of encouragement from you all. Thank you so much!

Over the past few days, the Lightracer development team has been collecting your feedback and suggestions. Based on these, we have made some quick adjustments.
While targeted optimizations are still ongoing, we hope this patch will enhance your gameplay experience.

Details are as follows:

Adjustments

[list]
[*] Optimized game frame rates.
[*] Increased mini-game rewards; [Decipher] will no longer deduct Merit points.
[*] Reduced the achievement points required for plugins like Hack and Connect.
[*] Boosted resource yields for permanent plugins like the Hack solidifier and Connect collection, making them more efficient.
[/list]
Bug Fixes

[list]
[*] Fixed storyline branch errors in Season 2 of Year 3413 involving Rau Telamon.
[*] Corrected three mismatches between news and events in Q3 of Year 3392.
[*] Fixed a rare issue triggered after clicking the “Reveal the destiny of civilization” button.
[*] Fixed a problem where resource values could drop into the negatives.
[*] Fixed issues with new encyclopedia hints not appearing after loading a save.
[*] Humbly corrected several typos pointed out by our players.
[/list]

Thank you again for your support and encouragement for the Lightracer series.
The journey through the cosmos is daunting, we wish you smooth sailing!

notes.title: Launch Day Hotfix Patch
notes.notes:
Fixes include:

Fixed potential storyline errors in Season 2 of Year 3413, Season 3 of Year 3393, and Season 1 of Year 3409.

Fixed an issue where the report button might not be visible.

Fixed an issue where rapidly dragging text could make selections unresponsive.

Thank you very much for your support, dear Judge!

If you encounter any new issues, feel free to report them via the in-game bug feedback link or by joining the official QQ group or Discord server!

notes.title: Release Date and Price of "Lightracer: For Judge" Announced
notes.notes:
Dear Judge,

We are thrilled to announce that "Lightracer: For Judge" has officially been scheduled for release!

The game will launch on January 8, 2025. It's priced at $9.99, with a special 10% off discount available during the first two weeks.

We truly value your feedback and suggestions, and our development team is committed to continuously updating and refining the game content. We warmly invite you to join our official discord where you can connect with creators and fellow players alike.

On January 8th, we look forward to welcoming you to the world of Ampharmonia!

Smartmelon Games

notes.title: Lightracer: For Judge official version postponed and Demo update
notes.notes:
Dear Judge,

We hope this message finds you well. We have an important update to share with everyone regarding the release of 'Lightracer: For Judge'. While we initially planned for a launch in the fourth quarter of 2024, we now anticipate releasing the game in the first half of 2025.

The primary reason for this delay is to ensure that 'Lightracer: For Judge' lives up to your expectations. With over 300,000 words of text and more intricate story branches and event impacts compared to its predecessor 'Lightracer Spark,' we find it necessary to take additional time for thorough testing and refinement. Our goal is to present the new Lightracer series installment in its best possible state, crafting a richer and more engaging science fiction experience just for you.

Moreover, our team has been diligently expanding the depth of the story. You may recall that the initial estimated word count for 'Lightracer: For Judge' was 250,000 words; however, we've since grown that number to an impressive 300,000 words. This expansion reflects our commitment to delivering a more comprehensive and immersive narrative.

While we understand how eagerly you await 'Lightracer: For Judge', we truly believe that this extra time will significantly enhance your gaming experience. As a token of our gratitude for your continued support, we're excited to announce an update to the demo version featuring [b]two additional quarters of storyline content[/b]. If you're eager for more before the official release, feel free to dive into these latest demo updates right away! 

Though our journey through the stars may be lengthy, we look forward with great anticipation to reuniting with you soon. Thank you all so much for your unwavering support and encouragement!

Warm regards,
Smartmelon Games

notes.title: DEMO Version Update: Content Additions and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Dear Judge,

Since the release of the DEMO version on October 14, we have received a wealth of feedback and suggestions. Thank you for your valuable input!

In this update, we are excited to announce the addition of two new quarters of gameplay content to the DEMO version. The storyline will now extend to the end of 3393 in Chapter Two!

Additionally, we have addressed several issues based on your feedback. Below are the specific adjustments made:

Bug Fixes:
- Resolved the issue where game button sounds could still be heard while the game is running in the background.
- Corrected the misalignment of narrative text when switching between certain screen resolutions.
- Fixed the formatting errors in some news content.
- Eliminated special grids that remained after brain power was applied.
- Rectified display issues in the English version that caused the interface to become disorganized due to UI character limits being exceeded.
- Addressed a number of typos and errors in the text.

Content Optimization:
- Updated the description of plug-ins that provide initial resources such as Cloud III.
- Modified the description of shortcut keys in the settings menu.
- Ensured that the bottom button does not remain visible while reading text.
- Introduced new pop-up prompts for resource changes.
- Improved wording and phrases in both Traditional Chinese and English.

"Lightracer：For Judge" is still in development. 

If you have any suggestions or ideas, please feel free to leave a message. 

You can also join our discord to reach the administrator or privately chat with the MR.Question to provide your feedback!

Thank you for your support!
